from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashReport(BaseModel):
    """The extracted financial data for a single company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company reported")
    cash_and_cash_equivalents_balance: float | None = Field(description="The 'Cash and Cash Equivalents Balance' amount from the cash flow statement")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned (e.g. '2024 Q1')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim text containing the cash balance figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted reports from the provided documents."""
    company_cash_reports: list[CompanyCashReport]
